reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate rather than adding a new date-formatting path.

duplication.why: The MM-DD match is a single added helper; no logic is copied.

placement.why: The holiday rule stays in shared/schedules.ts next to isNonWorkingDay, which every weekend/holiday adjustment path already uses.

scope.why: Only the holiday predicate and its tests change.

maintainability.why: A small named isHoliday helper makes the two accepted formats explicit at one point.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Goes through isNonWorkingDay, used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the weekend rule.
